name: Vegetable Crops Detection (VCD) - Maize
description:
This article introduces a dataset of vegetable crops. Maize (Zea mays) (this part), bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) and leek (Allium ampeloprasum) crops at an early stage of development (between 2 and 5 weeks from seeding of transplanting). Whole plants and stems have been annotated with bounding boxes. Collected under a shrouded platform with artificial light.

Data in Brief publication available here:
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2352340922002463

Every dataset in Weed-AI includes imagery of crops or pasture with weeds annotated, and is available in an MS-COCO derived format with standardised agricultural metadata.
citation: Lac, L., Keresztes, B., Louargant, M., Donias, M., & Da Costa, J. P. (2022). An annotated image dataset of vegetable crops at an early stage of growth for proximal sensing applications. Data in Brief, 42, 108035.

properties.Photography Description: Images collected under artificially controlled light conditions. A hull isolates the camera from the exterior and two 20 W led panels provide a constant and homogeneous scene illumination (source: Data in Brief).
